mode: read-only preparation; no B24 implementation, build, load or publication executed
startGate: B22 and B23 must complete their explicitly scoped Linux acceptance first. User-excluded 24h/72h rows stay unexecuted and qualified in downstream records.
conclusion: The old immutable 14-package component feed cannot satisfy the unchanged assembled A16/A22 native-manifest gate. Preserve all old bytes and versions as historical component evidence. New local package versions with the missing internal manifest and correctly bound facade version are necessary; no accepted package topology redesign or public domain publication is needed.

observedBlockers.name: missing-internal-native-manifest
observedBlockers.detail: SQLite, PostgreSQL and Server facade archives contain native libraries but no nativeweave/manifest.json. compatibility.package_payload requires and validates that member whenever expected.native is populated; omitting native from the expected record would bypass required validation.

observedBlockers.name: hardcoded-facade-version
observedBlockers.detail: DatabaseEngineProfile.Create and Server.Native.NativePackage bind descriptors to 0.1.0-preview.1. Provider generated output records also hardcode that version. PackageClosure exact facade checks and AssetLocation descriptor/output-record comparison would reject blindly relabeled packages.

externalSidecarDecision.allowed: A source-bound local release sidecar can retain package digests, exact source/build/native provenance, license and dependency audit evidence and prior acceptance references. Existing package bytes can be listed without modification.
externalSidecarDecision.insufficient: It cannot replace the required internal native-file identity manifest. D10 section9 explicitly places native-file hashes inside the package manifest, while package archive hashes remain outside. Adding internal members under an already existing ID/version would violate immutable identity.
externalSidecarDecision.minimumAction: Create fresh local native facade versions, include the internal manifest and actual retained license/NOTICE inventory material, and keep a source-bound external release record. Record absent/unverified provenance truthfully; do not fill placeholders.

minimalImplementationAfterStartGate.work: Reuse existing A16 packer/release and A22 strict payload/signature validation without weakening them. Stage the accepted actual domain native payloads at byte-identical hashes into fresh local facade versions, attach internal manifests, exact closure descriptors and source/license inventory; create matching complete previous/candidate fixture closures.

minimalImplementationAfterStartGate.owner: Root-coordinated minimal existing component integration patch
minimalImplementationAfterStartGate.work: Replace DatabaseEngineProfile hardcoded package version with the actual passed facade assembly informational version, normalized without source metadata; change SQLite/PostgreSQL generated asset record versions to the same build Version. Reuse existing ServerDiagnostics.Version or equivalent actual Server assembly version in NativePackage. These are private implementation/version-binding corrections, not new public APIs or Rust changes. They sit outside B24-exclusive folders and require explicit root coordination under the current task integration scope.

Only packages whose managed payload, native metadata or exact owned dependencies change need new versions. A minimal affected set is Database, Database.Sqlite, Database.PostgreSql, Server, Server.Grpc, Server.Mcp. Unchanged Core, Interop.Abi, Data, Data.Streaming, Database.Transactions, Query.Binding, Query.Generator and Server.Generator packages can retain original bytes/versions with exact edges. Final concrete build graph may require additional regenerated package bytes only if an actual owned edge changes.

Use two freshly produced local complete closure versions for honest package upgrade/downgrade and whole-closure rollback tests. Same native payloads are acceptable for package-version transitions but cannot be described as a native behavior upgrade. Retain historical preview.1 component consumption separately; it is not a formally complete prior A16 rollback closure because required native manifests are absent.

Run actual isolated SQLite, PostgreSQL and Server compositions plus independent/combined gRPC/MCP on the existing Rust Server host. Exercise exact closure, warned-and-suppressed overrides, missing native package/RID, corrupted native payload and incompatible ABI rejection, partial publication with no promoted catalog until complete destination restore/run, and new-process rollback. Reuse accepted A22 actual signing adapter evidence where applicable; do not claim a new public registry readback.

Use the existing Linux job/container facility for pristine no-Rust ordinary build/run, application Entity/DTO/Handler edits and AOT with unchanged native hashes. The current scratch host has no Docker/Podman socket; PATH filtering is not evidence of a pristine machine. Reuse the pinned A16 SDK/runtime images and tool-absence checks; add no platform/matrix.

mustPreserve: All existing package bytes, IDs and versions; create new local versions for changed payloads.
Exact native ELF/hash/ABI/source/owned-edge checks and signing-aware payload comparison.
Accepted A16/A22/B18/B19 component evidence; no historical task rerun or package topology redesign.
Exact license/NOTICE texts, Cargo.lock/features/source checksums and native build provenance.
No public domain package upload; only the normal existing post-merge preview workflow may publish within its established scope.
